working_title: Selective Support-Flow Candidate Generation with Cross-Slicer Verification for Build-Orientation Search
scientific_question: Can a dimensionless SFTF candidate generator abstain when its ranking signal is unreliable and remain noninferior to a verification-budget-matched uniform search on untouched meshes?
integrity_rules: All 41 meshes used in the PiAM-era analyses are development data and may not be counted as external validation.
The external mesh manifest may be inspected for geometry validity only; TOMO and slicer outcomes remain sealed until policy_lock.json is created and hashed.
No model, threshold, score weight, candidate count, verification budget, or stopping rule may change after the first external outcome is computed.
Legacy int16 TOMO outputs are provenance records only and may not enter any v2 endpoint.
Negative and zero reference support values are retained; no ratio-only endpoint may exclude them.

development.forbidden_claim: Development resampling, leave-one-out, and retrospective group splits are not external validation.

method_v2.legacy_implementation_policy: Frozen and retained only for reproduction of earlier results.
method_v2.surface_measure: Fixed deterministic normalized-area sample reused for every direction
method_v2.pair_tensor: F_pair=E_A[I_hit O/(1+lambda h/D) m_source outer m_receiver]
properties_to_verify: Rayleigh dependence on the symmetric tensor part only

policies_to_lock.uniform_baseline: Deterministic near-uniform spherical cells with exactly the same number of unique corrected-TOMO evaluations
policies_to_lock.sftf_branch: Low-score SFTF v2 basins expanded geodesically until exactly the matched budget is reached
policies_to_lock.selective_branch: Use SFTF only when the pre-locked uncertainty rule accepts; otherwise use uniform
uncertainty_features_allowed: top-set stability across 2048 and 4096 surface samples
policies_to_lock.status: Thresholds and tie-breaks must be written to policy_lock.json after development-only analysis and before any external outcome.

intermediate_backend.name: Corrected int32 TOMO / Tomo_Shell2026
intermediate_backend.role: Fast intermediate-fidelity exhaustive reference and matched-budget verifier
intermediate_backend.prohibition: Do not describe this backend as exact Cura.

verification.angle_alignment: Calibrate engine-specific support-angle conventions on synthetic overhang coupons before mesh outcomes; freeze the three configuration files and SHA256 hashes.
verification.cross_slicer_direction_panel: For each of the 30 preselected meshes, evaluate the same union of 64 fixed Fibonacci directions, all policy-selected finals, and predeclared local offsets in both modern Cura and Prusa.
verification.reference_warning: The best direction in a finite slicer panel is a panel reference, not a proven global optimum.

endpoints.primary_population: All 60 external meshes, including zero-support reference cases
endpoints.primary_metric: Grid-range-normalized corrected-TOMO regret: (V_policy - V_min)/(V_max - V_min), defined as zero when the range is numerically zero
endpoints.primary_contrast: Selective SFTF minus matched uniform, paired by mesh
endpoints.primary_analysis: Two-sided mesh-level paired bootstrap confidence interval plus paired permutation p-value; report mean, median, 90th percentile, maximum, and empirical CDF
endpoints.margin_lock_rule: The engineering justification and final margin must be frozen in policy_lock.json before external outcomes.
key_secondary: The same normalized-regret contrast separately in Cura 5.13 and Prusa 2.9.6 on the locked 30-mesh panel
Accepted-subset contrast and abstention coverage with confidence intervals
Spearman rank correlation and top-direction overlap between corrected TOMO, Cura, and Prusa
Wall-clock time including candidate generation, TOMO verification, and slicer verification
Legacy SFTF v1, SFTF v2 without abstention, and uniform ablations
endpoints.ratio_metric_policy: V_policy/V_min is secondary and is reported only where V_min is strictly positive.

required_failure_disclosures: Uniform is already stronger than legacy SFTF on the full development audit.
The earlier router and three-mesh split were retrospective.
TOMO is a proxy and previously overflow-affected outputs are invalid.
Cura and Prusa angle settings are not assumed numerically equivalent.
reporting.manuscript_rule: No numerical result may enter the v2 manuscript unless generated by the hashed manifest, policy lock, corrected backend, and frozen slicer configurations.
